{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the structure
df_info = trial_df.info()

# Check for duplicates and missing values
df_shape = trial_df.shape
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()
duplicate_rows = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Display the first few rows
df_head = trial_df.head()

# Check value counts for key columns
column_counts = {
    'arm': trial_df['arm'].value_counts(),
    'severity': trial_df['severity'].value_counts(),
    'responded': trial_df['responded'].value_counts()
}

# Return all results
df_info, df_shape, missing_values, duplicate_rows, df_head, column_counts"}
